name: Fivetran
description: Fivetran is an automated data movement platform that replicates data from databases, SaaS applications, and files into a data warehouse or lake, automatically handling schema drift along the way.
best_for: Data teams that want reliable, low-maintenance ELT pipelines from hundreds of database and SaaS sources into their warehouse without hand-building and maintaining custom connectors.
features: Large catalog of pre-built connectors (700+ on the Standard plan) spanning SaaS applications, databases, SAP, files, and streaming sources
Automated schema drift handling with automated data type promotion and validation as source schemas change
Idempotent, cursor-managed sync pipelines designed for data accuracy on every run
dbt Labs integration for orchestrating transformations after data lands in the warehouse
Support for data warehouse, data lake (open table format), and database destinations, plus destination-to-destination transfers and reverse-ETL style Activations
Connector SDK and a by-request program for building custom connectors beyond the pre-built catalog
SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS Level 1, HIPAA BAA, and HITRUST compliance certifications
pros: Free plan (up to 500K monthly active rows) is usable for small real projects, not just a demo
Unlimited users on paid plans — cost scales with data volume, not headcount
Broad compliance coverage (SOC 1/2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS Level 1, HIPAA BAA, HITRUST) available across its plans
cons: Pricing is based on Monthly Active Rows, so cost can be harder to predict in advance than a flat per-seat plan, especially as data volume grows
VPN tunnels and some security features (customer-managed encryption keys, PCI DSS Level 1) require the higher Enterprise or Business Critical plans

pricing.starting_price: Free up to 500K monthly active rows; paid usage from a $5/month base charge (covers up to 1M MAR)

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 500,000 monthly active rows (MAR) for connections, 3,500 MAR for activations, and 5,000 monthly model runs for transformations, at no cost.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: Unlimited users, 15-minute sync frequency, 700+ connectors. Usage-based billing starting at a $5 base charge covering 1 to 1,000,000 monthly active rows, then scaling with usage. Save up to 22% with an annual contract.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Adds 1-minute sync frequency, VPN tunnels (annual contract required), custom roles, and SCIM provisioning; custom consumption-based pricing.

tiers.name: Business Critical
tiers.notes: Adds customer-managed encryption keys, PCI DSS Level 1 certification, and private networking; custom consumption-based pricing.

alternatives.name: Segment
alternatives.description: Twilio's customer data platform (CDP), which collects first-party customer and event data and can route it into warehouses and other destinations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams whose main data-movement need is streaming product and customer event data into a warehouse or downstream tools, rather than replicating databases and SaaS-application tables.
strengths: Identity resolution and unified customer profiles
Broad library of destinations beyond warehouses

faq.question: Does Fivetran have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Fivetran's Free plan covers up to 500,000 monthly active rows for connections, 3,500 MAR for activations, and 5,000 monthly transformation model runs at no cost.

faq.question: How is Fivetran priced above the free tier?
faq.answer: Paid plans bill on Monthly Active Rows (MAR) consumed, starting with a $5 base charge covering 1 to 1,000,000 MAR on the Standard plan, then scaling with usage. Annual contracts can save up to 22% versus paying monthly.

faq.question: Does Fivetran support transformations, or just data movement?
faq.answer: Fivetran integrates with dbt Labs to orchestrate transformations after data lands in the destination, in addition to its core connector-based data movement.
